name: Battle of Kosovo
summary: On June 28, 1389 (St. Vitus's Day / Vidovdan), Ottoman Sultan Murad I confronts a coalition of Serbian, Bosnian, Albanian, and Wallachian forces under Prince Lazar Hrebeljanović on Kosovo Polje (the 'Field of Blackbirds'). Both commanders die: Murad I is assassinated by the Serbian nobleman Miloš Obilić, and Prince Lazar is captured and executed after the battle. The Ottomans win tactically; the Serbian principality becomes an Ottoman vassal. Kosovo becomes the defining myth of Serbian national identity for centuries.

_quarry.structural_significance: Establishes Ottoman dominance over the Balkans; creates the Serbian national epic around Lazar's sacrifice; opens the road to further Ottoman expansion into Europe
